senses.gloss: This maxim refers to an anecdote. The ocean used to destroy the eggs of a female osprey. The male bird lodged a complaint with Garuḍa who reported the matter to Viṣṇu. At the behest of Viṣṇu, Garuda began to dry up the ocean by flapping his huge wings. The ocean felt frightened and returned the eggs to the osprey. The moral of this story and maxim is that God helps those who are diligent and are devotees of Him. Secondly a man can do wonders if he is of firm mind and takes firm decisions.
